text:
Predicates:
British(x) ::: x is British.
SitcomSeries(x) ::: x is a sitcom series.
Starring(x, y) ::: x stars y.
Piloted(x, y, z) ::: x piloted in y on z.
WorkingTitle(x, y) ::: x has a working title y.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x is the script editor for y.
Premises:
British(badults) ∧ SitcomSeries(badults) ∧ Starring(badults, Pappys) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series, starring members of Pappy's.
Piloted(badults, July2013, BBCThree) ::: Badults piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
WorkingTitle(badults, TheSecretDudeSociety) ::: The Working title "The Secret Dude Society" was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, series(WorkingTitle, TheSecretDudeSociety)) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for a series with the working title "The Secret Dude Society".
